message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **long‑weekend** holidays that Canadians will enjoy in 2023 (i.e., a holiday falling on a Monday or Friday, or an observed holiday that creates a three‑day stretch).  Dates are shown as the full weekend span:

| Holiday | Date(s) | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Family Day** | **Feb 18–20** | Observed on Monday Feb 20 (most provinces). |
| **Good Friday** | **Apr 7–9** | Friday Apr 7 plus the weekend. |
| **Victoria Day** | **May 20–22** | Observed on Monday May 22. |
| **Canada Day** | **Jul 1–3** | Official holiday on Saturday Jul 1; observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Labour Day** | **Sep 2–4** | Observed on Monday Sep 4. |
| **Thanksgiving** | **Oct 7–9** | Observed on Monday Oct 9. |
| **Remembrance Day** | **Nov 9–11** | Observed on Monday Nov 11. |
| **Christmas** | **Dec 23–25** | Observed on Monday Dec 25. |

*Boxing Day (Dec 26) falls on a Tuesday, so it does not create a long weekend on its own.*

Feel free to plug these dates straight into your holiday‑planning app!
